useCases.title: Network Segmentation Monitoring
useCases.value: IT/OT network boundary violations create cybersecurity risk to critical infrastructure. Continuous monitoring validates segmentation.

useCases.title: PLC Firmware Change Detection
useCases.value: Unexpected firmware changes on PLCs can be maintenance errors or malicious reprogramming.

useCases.title: Modbus Register Value Change Tracking
useCases.value: Covert changes to holding registers can alter setpoints or interlocks; comparing matched request/response values highlights tampering distinct from normal operator writes.

useCases.title: OT Device Authentication Failure Detection
useCases.value: OT security platforms detect login failure events including the number of failed authentication attempts and the protocol used. Brute-force login attempts against HMIs, engineering workstations, or w…

useCases.title: IEC 62443 Zone and Conduit Compliance Monitoring
useCases.value: IEC 62443 requires industrial networks to be segmented into security zones connected by controlled conduits. OT security platforms help control engineers define these zones and automatically detect c…

useCases.title: NAC Policy Change Audit
useCases.value: NAC policy changes affect network access for all devices. Unauthorized changes can create security gaps or disrupt access.

useCases.title: Micro-Segmentation Audit
useCases.value: Micro-segmentation limits lateral movement. Audit logs validate policy enforcement and detect bypasses.

useCases.title: OT Security Policy Control Evidence from Log Review
useCases.value: Correlates policy-required controls (access, change, remote sessions) to indexed evidence so the IACS security program can demonstrate ongoing compliance with documented requirements.

useCases.title: IACS Cyber Risk Assessment — Critical OT Asset Exposure
useCases.value: Surfaces internet-facing or high-CVSS OT assets to inform documented risk treatment and residual risk acceptance for the IACS.

useCases.title: OT Security Awareness Training Completion
useCases.value: Measures completion of OT-specific training by role so awareness obligations for personnel working on IACS are auditable.

useCases.title: Privileged OT Account Changes vs Personnel Screening
useCases.value: Flags new or elevated OT privileged accounts that lack matching screening status, supporting personnel security for IACS access paths.

useCases.title: IACS Incident Response Containment Interval
useCases.value: Quantifies detection-to-containment for OT cyber incidents and separates drills from production to evidence an exercised IR plan.

useCases.title: Control System Continuity — Historian Export and OT Backup Health
useCases.value: Detects missed historian snapshots or failed OT-tier backups that undermine recovery time objectives for control systems.

useCases.title: OT Security Audit Population Sampling Dashboard
useCases.value: Delivers repeatable audit samples of OT security-relevant events across zones for internal and external assessments of the security program.

useCases.title: OT Change Management — PLC Download Without CM Ticket
useCases.value: Correlates controller downloads or online edits with change tickets to enforce controlled maintenance for IACS devices.

useCases.title: Physical Access vs OT Network First-Seen Asset
useCases.value: Relates physical access events to new or unknown OT assets appearing on protected VLANs to strengthen environmental controls narrative.

useCases.title: Vendor Remote Maintenance Window and Dual-Control Evidence
useCases.value: Monitors vendor VPN and PSM sessions against contracted hours and approval records to evidence supplier risk management for OT maintenance.

useCases.title: HMI and Jump Host Human User Identification Gaps
useCases.value: Detects interactive OT logons missing identifiable human user mapping to support unique identification of people accessing IACS UIs.

useCases.title: Non-Interactive Industrial Protocol Clients Without Device Identity
useCases.value: Finds Modbus/OPC-UA sessions where client identity cannot be tied to an approved automation asset, weakening software process and device identification.

useCases.title: Stale or Shared OT Service Accounts
useCases.value: Surfaces OT accounts with weak rotation, excessive group breadth, or shared naming patterns inconsistent with IACS account management practice.

useCases.title: Weak OTP or Missing MFA Step for OT VPN
useCases.value: Identifies VPN authentications that skip second factor or reuse legacy token methods for paths into OT jump zones.

useCases.title: Short or Default Password Patterns in OT Authentication Logs
useCases.value: Uses policy checks on authentication metadata (where available) and heuristics on failed logon bursts to catch weak password hygiene in OT accounts.

useCases.title: Certificate-Based OPC-UA Logon Failures and Weak Trust Stores
useCases.value: Tracks OPC-UA secure channel failures and untrusted issuer patterns to validate strength of public-key authentication for industrial servers.

useCases.title: OT Access from Untrusted Networks Without Split Tunnel Block
useCases.value: Flags VPN or agent sessions originating from high-risk geos or residential ASNs while accessing OT jump portals.

useCases.title: Unauthorized Writes to Modbus Holding Registers
useCases.value: Detects Modbus function codes that modify process values from hosts not authorized for write operations.

useCases.title: Unsigned Macros or Scripts Executed on Engineering Workstation
useCases.value: Monitors execution of script engines and office macros from OT engineering hosts where mobile code should be restricted.

useCases.title: HMI Session Lock Bypass — Long Idle Operator Consoles
useCases.value: Measures continuous HMI operator sessions without screen-lock events to evidence session lock policy effectiveness.

useCases.title: Forced Remote Engineering Session Termination After Hours
useCases.value: Ensures vendor and internal remote sessions to OT are closed at shift end by correlating still-active tunnels with schedule.

useCases.title: OT Auditable Event Coverage by Zone and Source
useCases.value: Compares expected auditable sources per IEC 62443 zone to actual indexed event rates to find blind spots.

useCases.title: Audit Index Growth vs Licensed Retention (Capacity Risk)
useCases.value: Forecasts `ot_audit` disk usage to avoid silent loss of security audit records before policy retention is met.

useCases.title: Forwarder Stops — Audit Pipeline Failure Response
useCases.value: Detects universal forwarder or OT collector outages that stop security-relevant events reaching the SIEM.

useCases.title: Clock Skew on OT Hosts vs NTP Stratum
useCases.value: Surfaces OT servers and RTUs with large `_indextime` vs `_time` deltas undermining trustworthy audit timestamps.

useCases.title: Dual-Signature PLC Program Change Without Four-Eyes Ticket
useCases.value: Looks for PLC program uploads/downloads signed by only one engineering identity when policy requires dual control.

useCases.title: OPC-UA Message Tampering Indicators via Signature Failures
useCases.value: Raises alerts when OPC-UA signing/encryption modes downgrade or signature checks fail, indicating integrity issues on industrial sessions.

useCases.title: PLC Firmware Verification Job Failures
useCases.value: Tracks scheduled integrity or attestation jobs on controllers that fail or never run, weakening verification of security functionality.

useCases.title: Unexpected PLC Logic CRC Change
useCases.value: Compares reported logic checksums or project CRCs to last approved baseline to detect unauthorized software changes.

useCases.title: Out-of-Range SCADA Setpoints and Invalid Control Commands
useCases.value: Validates control writes against engineering limits and recipe tables to catch dangerous setpoint or mode commands.

useCases.title: Cleartext Industrial Credentials in PCAP-Derived Metadata
useCases.value: Scans IDS metadata for username or password fields in cleartext industrial protocols where confidentiality must be preserved.

useCases.title: Deprecated TLS or SSH Algorithms on OT Jump Hosts
useCases.value: Lists sessions negotiating weak ciphers for OT administrative channels where cryptography policy must be enforced.

useCases.title: East-West OT Traffic Crossing Intended Purdue Levels
useCases.value: Detects flows between OT zones that should communicate only through defined conduits, evidencing segmentation policy.

useCases.title: Denied Exploit Attempts at OT DMZ Boundary
useCases.value: Aggregates blocked threats at OT firewall and IDS boundaries to prove active zone boundary protection.

useCases.title: Mixed Safety and Non-Safety Traffic on Same VLAN Evidence
useCases.value: Correlates asset roles from inventory with L2/L3 observations to highlight application partitioning violations between safety and non-safety systems.

useCases.title: PLC Local Console Login Without Corporate Identity
useCases.value: Finds controller-local or maintenance port logins that cannot be mapped to a named human, weakening component-level identification.

useCases.title: Unauthorized Firmware Upload Attempt on RTU
useCases.value: Detects firmware or OS image transfer sessions to RTUs from non-engineering hosts, testing authorization enforcement on components.

useCases.title: Embedded PLC Audit Log Forwarding Gaps
useCases.value: Identifies PLCs that stopped emitting security audit events to Splunk compared to a seven-day baseline.

useCases.title: Secure Boot or Image Hash Mismatch on Industrial Appliance
useCases.value: Correlates component attestation failures with subsequent process alarms to prioritize firmware integrity incidents.

useCases.title: Modbus Serial Gateway Exposing Registers to Wrong TCP Subnet
useCases.value: Flags TCP-side Modbus requests from subnets that should not see serial-segment registers, supporting confidentiality on component channels.

useCases.title: Duplicate IP or MAC on OT Switch — Segmentation Violation
useCases.value: Surfaces ARP/ND anomalies that indicate bridging or misconfiguration undermining component-level network segmentation.

useCases.title: High-Rate Modbus Exception Responses (Potential DoS)
useCases.value: Detects exception storms targeting PLCs that may indicate denial-of-service attacks against control I/O.

useCases.title: PLC CPU Load and Scan Cycle Degradation
useCases.value: Monitors embedded controller resource metrics to catch resource exhaustion from misconfiguration or attack precursors.

useCases.title: Redundant Controller Failover During Attack Window
useCases.value: Correlates IDS alerts with DCS redundancy state changes to evidence availability protections via backup paths.

useCases.title: Historian Query Saturation During Incident
useCases.value: Tracks historian and OPC query rates to ensure analytical consumers do not starve operators during sustained attacks or mis-tuned reports.

useCases.title: Zone Boundary Traffic Monitoring — Anomalous Inter-Zone Volume
useCases.value: Baselines permitted bytes and sessions between OT zones and flags spikes that may indicate policy drift, covert channels, or misrouted traffic at conduits.

useCases.title: Conduit Traffic Allowlist Enforcement — Unexpected DNP3 Functions
useCases.value: Detects DNP3 function codes on encrypted OT tunnels that are not in the approved conduit function matrix.

useCases.title: Cross-Zone Protocol Anomaly Detection — IEC 61850 GOOSE Floods
useCases.value: Spots unusual GOOSE/AppID volumes between substation zones indicating mis-wiring, VLAN bleed, or malicious injection.

useCases.title: Safety Zone Isolation Verification — Non-Safety OPC on SIS VLAN
useCases.value: Identifies OPC-UA or HMI sessions sourced from assets tagged non-safety on safety-controller VLANs.

useCases.title: DMZ Integrity Between IT and OT — Corporate Browser to OT HMI
useCases.value: Finds IT-originated web traffic reaching OT HMIs that should only be reachable via bastion or reverse proxy in the DMZ.

useCases.title: Engineering Workstation Access Control — RDP Skips Jump Tier
useCases.value: Alerts when RDP/WinRM sessions skip the jump tier and land directly on low-Purdue controllers or Windows I/O servers.

useCases.title: Historian-to-Corporate Data Flow Audit — Large ODBC Without SPN
useCases.value: Tracks large ODBC/JDBC pulls from OT historian to corporate subnets missing service principal authentication.

useCases.title: Wireless Zone Security Monitoring — Unknown Clients on OT SSID
useCases.value: Lists Wi-Fi associations to OT WLANs from unknown MAC vendors or non-instrumentation OUI prefixes.

useCases.title: Remote Access Conduit Integrity — Split Tunnel on OT VPN Portal
useCases.value: Detects GlobalProtect configurations that expose split routing while OT portals should force tunnel-all.

useCases.title: Zone Trust Level Verification — SL-T vs Observed Purdue Layer
useCases.value: Joins SL-T/Criticality from inventory to observed Purdue level to find assets operating below required trust level for their criticality.

name: IEC 62443 Industrial Automation and Control Systems Security
